message:
Now let me understand the vulnerability better. The key issue is in `decode_dns_labels`:

```c
slen = fr_dns_label_uncompressed_length(packet_ctx->packet, data, data + data_len - packet_ctx->packet, &next, packet_ctx->lb);
```

Here `buf = data` and `buf_len = data + data_len - packet_ctx->packet`. So `end = buf + buf_len = data + data + data_len - packet`. This is `data + data_len + (data - packet)`. Since `data >= packet`, `end` extends beyond the actual data end by `(data - packet)` bytes.

This means `fr_dns_label_uncompressed_length` can read up to `(data - packet)` bytes past the end of the actual buffer. This is the heap-buffer-overflow READ.

Let me look at how the DNS packet is structured. The DNS header is 12 bytes. Then questions, then RRs. The `data` pointer passed to `decode_dns_labels` is the start of the name field within a question or RR record.

Let me look at the dictionary to understand the DNS attribute structure.

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>find /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/freeradius-server -name "*.dict" -path "*dns*" | head; echo "---"; find /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/freeradius-server -name "dictionary*" -path "*dns*" | head; echo "---"; ls /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/freeradius-server/share/dictionary/</｜｜DSML｜｜>
